method: Manual visual reading of the supplied original PDF pages; PII and originals retained outside repository. These expectations are separate from model outputs and synthetic unit tests.

criteria.expected: Annual check-up and medically necessary diagnostic cover EUR 2000 / 0% participation are distinct benefits, never one check-up allowance.
Check-up once per insurance year; do not substitute calendar year.
Annual check-up and prenatal check-up share an exclusion in the same insurance year; prenatal eligibility is conditional, not a universal recommendation.
Contact coordination centre, identification and active cover. Diagnostic examinations additionally need a physician referral issued within 30 days.
Check-up waiting period 30 days after initial start/reinstatement; prenatal after first insurance year. Renewal does not automatically restart waiting.
Preventive referrals excluded except the explicitly covered annual check-up. Do not apply the diagnostic exclusion to remove that check-up.
USA hospitalization 10% contribution in addition to deductible; renewal preserves existing special conditions. Do not apply this to outpatient check-up.
Original 2024-05-22/2025-05-22, renewal 2026-05-22/2027-05-22. Missing 2025-2026 evidence, not proof of lapse.
Renewal depends on payment; paid/active status remains unconfirmed.
Summary of hospital amendments refers to full revised wording not supplied. Keep a review issue rather than invent replacement terms.
Medical assistance and emergency transport are incident preparation/services, not prevention of the event.
